storage: Keep it whole and unwashed, in a cool spot or the fridge vegetable drawer, loosely wrapped, for up to about a week. Do not stack heavy items on it, because it bruises easily. Roasted and mashed brinjal (before tempering) keeps in a closed box in the fridge for 1–2 days.
looksLike: A big, round or oval brinjal, usually 400–700 g each, with smooth, glossy, dark-purple skin and a green cap and stem. It is far larger than the small round or long thin brinjals used in sambar and bhaji. A pale-green bharta type is also sold, but the purple one is the usual choice.
shelfLife: 3–5 days at room temperature, up to about a week in the fridge.

usedIn.raw: 300 g as bought per serving (1 large round brinjal; about 240 g flesh after removing the stem and skin)
